    1. render(BuiltImmersiveRenderState, PoseStack, ImmersiveRenderHelpers, float, int)

Interface ExtraRenderer<ER>

Type Parameters:
ER - The extra data passed to rendering. This is the second class passed to BlockBasedImmersiveBuilder.copy(BlockBasedImmersiveHandler, Class, Class, BiConsumer).
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ExtraRenderer<ER>
A functional interface for BuiltBlockBasedImmersives for providing additional rendering functionality.

    • render

      void render(BuiltImmersiveRenderState<ER> renderState, com.mojang.blaze3d.vertex.PoseStack stack, ImmersiveRenderHelpers helpers, float partialTick, int light)
      Called when rendering after hitboxes have been rendered.
      Parameters:
      renderState - The render state that was rendered.
      stack - The pose stack being rendered with.
      helpers - Some helper functions for rendering.
      partialTick - The fraction of time between the last tick and the current tick.
      light - The light value for the Immersive.
